user.title: Competitions
user.description: Choose the competitions Fußball-Assist should answer questions about. All are selected by default; at least one is required.

data_description.wettbewerbe: The clubs offered in the next step come from the selected competitions.

vereine.title: Favorite clubs
vereine.description: A question without a club name ("How did we do?") refers to the main club. Both fields are optional; the men's teams of the selected competitions are offered.

data_description.hauptverein: The club meant when no club is named. Leave empty if there is none.
data_description.lieblingsvereine: Their matches come first in the weekly overview and in long match lists.

error.nicht_erreichbar: OpenLigaDB is not reachable right now. Please try again in a moment.

abort.saison_fehlt: There is no season file for the current season. An update of the integration is needed.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Fußball-Assist is already set up. Only one setup is possible.

saison_fehlt.title: Fußball-Assist has no data for season {saison}
saison_fehlt.description: There is no season file for season {saison}, so Fußball-Assist cannot answer questions about matches, tables or top scorers. An update of the integration is needed. This message disappears once it is installed and Home Assistant has been restarted.

kuerzel_unbekannt.title: Fußball-Assist does not know competitions of season {saison}
kuerzel_unbekannt.description: OpenLigaDB has no league with the shortcuts {kuerzel} for season {saison}, so the matching competitions return no data. OpenLigaDB may have changed the shortcuts or not created the league yet. An update of the integration may be needed.
